comment: Requirement flow routing. The Bridge ships this file as its defaults; hq/harness/requirement-flow.json (or LAA_BRIDGE_FLOW_CONFIG) overrides key by key. Changing the adviser or an implementation model is an edit here, not a code change. An entry with enabled:false is never used and must carry the reason.

advisorProfiles.reason: waiting for contract: Google AI Ultra 20x is not contracted yet (Gemini via Antigravity). Switch on only after the owner contracts it and the pool reports available.

implementation.comment: Session parents: Claude Code Opus Medium for ordinary work, DSH DeepSeek High (OpenCode Go) for procedure-defined work. GPT/Codex/Pi and Devin profiles are not routes of this flow; a design that names one falls back to defaultProfile.

inbox.comment: Every root session's return lands in the inbox. A verification turn is spent on sessions linked to a requirement or flow, on errors of such sessions, and on origins listed in verifyOrigins; the rest is recorded for the digest.
